name: base590h
note: control arm, no overrides -- the anchor. Fresh name (not 'baseline'/'baseline590'): the shared results volume banks rows BY ARM NAME, and a prior wave's rows at another commit would satisfy the resume check and silently poison the anchor. First in the list, so check_sweep.py uses it as the base arm.

name: h_v1flat_01
note: REPLICATION arm: the sets1-10 corpus winner verbatim (hist_v1style, -54 paired verdict / -16%, 18W/14L). Diffuse flat field -- contest event + whole-footprint rip stamps + raw frontier at 0.25, flat accumulation, dose 0.1 / cap 0.5. Sets 11-20 are a holdout it has never seen; if the win does not reproduce here it was corpus-specific and must not become a default.

name: h_v1flat_02
note: DOSE LADDER up: the winner's shape at 2x dose, cap held at the same 5-increment ratio (0.2 / 1.0). Asks whether more of the winning ingredient keeps helping or starts walling off escape fields (the failure mode that sank the escalating arms on fine-pitch BGAs: orangecrab +28, ulx3s +28, zynq7020 +24).

name: h_v1flat_005
note: DOSE LADDER down: half dose, same 5-increment cap ratio (0.05 / 0.25). Brackets the optimum from below and tests whether a gentler field keeps the thrash-regime win while sparing the BGA escape fields.

name: h_flat_contest
note: INGREDIENT ATTRIBUTION, rung 1 of 3 (all at dose 0.1 / cap 0.5): contest event ONLY, flat. This is the missing cell of the sets1-10 2x2 -- that wave tested contest-only ESCALATING (+39, worst) and diffuse FLAT (-54, best), so it cannot tell whether the win came from FLATNESS or from DIFFUSENESS. This arm separates them.

name: h_flat_frontier
note: INGREDIENT ATTRIBUTION, rung 2 of 3: contest + raw blocked frontier (0.25), flat, NO whole-footprint rip stamps. Isolates the rip stamp, which the v1 diagnosis specifically suspected of being redundant with the rra ghost (same 0.1 mm-equivalent, inside the ghost's wider 1.0 mm radius) and actively harmful after the C1 delete, when it permanently prices vacated, now-uncontested ground. Rung 3 is h_v1flat_01 (contest + frontier + rips).
